title: nTransactions Android APK v1.0
message: The official Android APK is available from the nTransactions download page.
changelog: Cross-platform update awareness system
Service Worker update prompt support
Android APK version comparison support
Official first-time APK download page
Improved Settings profile card and detailed Profile window

android.title: nTransactions v3.0 is here
android.message: A major update with AI-powered features — Finance Assistant, Voice Transaction, Smart SMS Detection, Invite & Earn, and a fully redesigned sign-in screen.
changelog: Finance Assistant — AI chat for your spending insights
Voice Transaction — add transactions by speaking
Smart SMS Detection — auto-parse bank & MFS messages
Invite & Earn — share your referral link and earn Cons
Email Link (passwordless) sign-in
Redesigned sign-in screen with glassmorphism
Improved notifications with clear read/unread distinction
Share loan & deposit receipts as short branded links
Sign Out button added to Settings
Wallet reorder drag-and-drop fixed on Android

web.title: What's New in nTransactions
web.message: PWA users can now see release notes and reload when a fresh deployment is available.
changelog: What's New announcement system
Service Worker update detection
Manual Check for Updates from Settings
Compact Settings profile card and Profile details modal
